transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?
I guess… I haven’t really been eating much. Like at work, on lunch, I’ll get food I used to like and just kind of stare at it, then throw most of it away. That’s mostly why I came in.
Have you been feeling down or losing interest in things you used to enjoy?

Yeah… I guess I don’t really get into things like I used to. Gallery nights, basketball, going for tacos, helping kids with art stuff… I used to look forward to that. Lately I just kind of stand there feeling nothing, and then I usually make some excuse to leave.
Have you noticed feeling more tired or lacking energy lately, even when you haven't been doing much?
Yeah… by like halfway through a shift, I feel kind of weighed down. Even just fixing racks or walking to the stockroom feels like it takes more effort than it should.
Have you found that you don't take pleasure in things that used to make you happy, like helping kids with art or going to gallery nights?
Yeah… I mean, those things used to be fun. Gallery nights, basketball, tacos, helping the kids with art stuff. Lately I just kind of feel flat when I’m there, and I usually find a reason to leave.
How long have you been feeling this way?
Maybe… about two months. Around when that window display thing happened, with the award and the district manager paying attention. Since then, I guess.
Can you tell me more about how you’ve been feeling during these activities—like, do you still enjoy them at all, or does it feel like you’re just going through the motions?

Mostly it feels like I’m just… there. Like with gallery nights or basketball or grabbing tacos, I used to look forward to it. Same with helping kids with art stuff. Now I kind of stand around feeling flat, and after a while I’ll make some excuse to leave.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently?
Yeah… my appetite’s been pretty bad. I barely want to eat. Like at work, on lunch, I’ll get food I used to like and just kind of stare at it… then throw most of it away.
Have you noticed yourself moving slower than usual or feeling restless and unable to sit still?
I don’t really know. I haven’t noticed moving slower exactly… or being too restless. I just feel kind of off, I guess.
Would you say you’ve been feeling down or depressed most days, even if it’s not severe?
I don’t know… I guess I’ve been kind of low a lot. It’s hard to say if it’s “most days,” but… yeah, not really myself.
Would you say that your low mood and lack of interest in activities have been present most of the time over the past two weeks?

Yeah… I think so. I mean, stuff I used to actually look forward to—gallery nights, basketball, getting tacos from the trucks… even helping kids with art stuff—I just kind of show up and feel flat. Most times I end up making some excuse to leave.
Would you say that you’ve completely stopped enjoying things you used to like, like helping kids with art or going to gallery nights, rather than just feeling a little less interested?

Yeah… pretty much. I used to actually get excited for stuff like gallery nights or basketball, or helping kids with art. Lately I’m just kind of there… flat. I usually end up leaving early or making some excuse.
Have you found yourself feeling more guilty or worthless than usual, even about things that wouldn’t have bothered you before?

Yeah… I guess. I keep thinking I didn’t really earn the award, or the chance at supervisor. Like I somehow fooled people into thinking I’m better than I am. They tell me that’s not true, but… it still feels like I tricked everyone.
Have you had any thoughts about hurting yourself or that life isn’t worth living?
I don’t think so… not hurting myself. I’ve just been feeling really low.
Would you say that your lack of energy or feeling weighed down has been present nearly every day, even when you're not doing much?
Yeah… most days, I guess. By halfway through a shift I feel really heavy, like even straightening racks or walking back to the stockroom takes more out of me than it should.
Would you say that you’ve completely stopped being able to feel any pleasure or joy in things you used to like, like helping kids with art or going to gallery nights, even for a moment?

Yeah… kind of. I mean, I’ll still go sometimes, but it’s not the same. Gallery nights, basketball, grabbing tacos, helping kids with art stuff… I used to actually look forward to that. Lately I just feel flat, and I usually find some excuse to leave.
Have these feelings made it hard for you to function at work or in your usual daily activities?

Yeah… I’m still showing up to work, but I’ve been messing up stuff I usually handle fine. Inventory counts, display plans… my manager’s had to check behind me.

And outside work I’ve been skipping things more. Gallery nights, basketball, the youth art workshops… I just haven’t been going much.
